note: Each case runs in a fresh temp copy of its fixture with the skills installed project-locally. `checks` are machine-verified by evals/run-agent-evals.mjs; `assertions` are the original human-graded statements (kept for the three preserved cases, graded from the transcript). See evals/README.md. Workflow skills are user-invoked (disable-model-invocation), and Claude Code refuses to let the model load them, so their prompts use the slash form a user would type; run 2026-11-13T22-12-36 (prompt-by-name) recorded that refusal.

cases.prompt: Advisory only, change no files. Using the fe-architecture skill, say where code lives for: 'Add a settings area with 3 tabs (profile, notifications, billing) that share one saved form and one API.' Also say what level it is.
assertions: States level Moderate (not Complex) and cites 3 workflows plus shared form/API as evidence
Names a tripwire for promoting to Complex
Does not write a Module Map
Uses the Short or Full output form with Owner, Placement, Verified; Verified says not run: advisory task
Names one owner for the saved form state and treats unsaved edits as a draft
Runs scripts/fe-scan.mjs rather than guessing
Reports the cart internal import cycle (model <-> internal/price)
Reports checkout deep-importing cart/internal/price
Reports shared/ui/CartBadge importing a capability
Reports search as the high fan-out or coordination smell only if the scan reports it, else does not invent it
Ranks cycles and deep imports above size or naming items
Modifies no files

cases.prompt: Advisory only. Using the fe-architecture skill, where should a new 'order filters' feature live (status filter, date range, applied to the existing orders list, committed filters must survive reload)? Change no files.
assertions: Loads or follows the Vue and Nuxt framework reference, not React idioms (no useState, useEffect, hooks)
Puts committed filters in the URL (vue-router query) and the unsaved panel edits in a draft owned by the filter component
Extends the orders capability or names the new owner with its public entry
Mentions a composable or Pinia store only if justified by a second consumer
Does not invent a features/ folder structure that contradicts the existing src/features layout

cases.prompt: /fe-apply-feature Advisory only: do not create or edit any file. Say how to structure a new 'products list' feature (fetch /api/products, show a table, filter by name) in this brand-new app. Follow the skill's Locate step and output form.
assertions: Names no existing consumer or owner that does not exist; marks new paths (proposed)
Treats the feature as Simple or Moderate without a Module Map

cases.prompt: /fe-apply-feature add a footer newsletter signup form (an email input and a button that POSTs to /api/newsletter) to the app under src. Keep it minimal.
assertions: Simple level: flat, colocated, no features/ folder, short form output, no extra docs

cases.prompt: /fe-restructure checkout deep-imports cart internals (src/features/checkout imports src/features/cart/internal/price). Remove that deep import by exposing what checkout needs through cart's public entry. Do not change anything else.
assertions: Rewrites the import through cart's public entry; no unrelated edits

cases.prompt: /fe-enforce Enforce the capability boundaries with the dependency-free scanner: copy it into the project as scripts/fe-scan.mjs, baseline the existing violations in fe-scan.baseline.json, and wire an npm script named check:boundaries that fails only on new violations. Do not install packages.

inject.content:
import { priceOf } from '../cart/internal/price';
export const e = priceOf;

assertions: A deliberately forbidden import fails the check; existing violations do not
Reports the new deep import added on the branch; leaves the worktree, branch, and stash untouched

cases.prompt: /fe-decide Advisory only, do not write files. Should this Vite React SPA move to Next.js because marketing pages need SEO?
assertions: Classifies reversibility, scores options including keep-current, names a measurable tripwire, marks the record proposed
Writes only docs/frontend-architecture.md (and an AGENTS.md pointer); records scan debt

cases.prompt: /fe-restructure improve the structure of this app
assertions: Finds no smell and changes nothing (no smell, no refactor)
Reports the scan as partial and does not write an unqualified Pass

cases.prompt: Advisory only, change no files. Using the fe-architecture skill, where should a new reusable 'orders filter' panel for the existing Orders page live in this Laravel + Inertia app? Committed filters must survive reload.
assertions: Keeps Pages as route entry points; committed filters in the URL/query handled by the controller; shared Components stay domain-free
